commit 555dad7d531eead3eff30fc00682177a212f985f
Author:     Magnus Melin <mkmelin+mozilla@iki.fi>
AuthorDate: Wed Jun 11 10:37:37 2025 +0000
Commit:     Magnus Melin <mkmelin+mozilla@iki.fi>
CommitDate: Wed Jun 11 10:37:37 2025 +0000

    Bug 1971216 - Fix v128/v140 folderCache.json incompatiblity on Win and Mac due to "thunderbird" vs "Thunderbird" MOZ_APP_PROFILE. r=#thunderbird-reviewers
    
    
    Grabbed some info from https://hg-edge.mozilla.org/mozilla-central/rev/9da7c485ae72#l5.31
    
    Based on https://github.com/Betterbird/thunderbird-patches/blob/main/140/bugs/1971216-profile-directory-uppercase.patch
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D253314

diff --git a/mail/moz.configure b/mail/moz.configure
index 7a9c4d4dabe..3074a043e60 100644
--- a/mail/moz.configure
+++ b/mail/moz.configure
@@ -8,7 +8,20 @@ set_config("MOZ_THUNDERBIRD", True)
 set_define("MOZ_THUNDERBIRD", True)
 
 imply_option("MOZ_APP_NAME", "thunderbird")
-imply_option("MOZ_APP_PROFILE", "thunderbird")
+
+# MOZ_APP_PROFILE: When set, used for application.ini's
+# "Profile" field, which controls profile location.
+if target_is_windows or target_is_osx:
+    imply_option("MOZ_APP_PROFILE", "Thunderbird")
+else:
+    imply_option("MOZ_APP_PROFILE", "thunderbird")
+
+# MOZ_APP_BASENAME: Typically stays consistent for multiple branded
+# versions of a given application (e.g. Daily and Thunderbird both use
+# "Thunderbird"), but may vary for full rebrandings. Used
+# for application.ini's "Name" field, which controls profile location in
+# the absence of a "Profile" field, and various system
+# integration hooks (Unix remoting, Windows MessageWindow name, etc.)
 imply_option("MOZ_APP_BASENAME", "Thunderbird")
 set_config("MOZ_APPUPDATE_HOST", "aus.thunderbird.net")
